snippet.title: Attacking the Tower - Teaser Trailer (Henry Stickmin Fangame)
snippet.description:
2025 UPDATE: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7QEgU2P_MGs

Attacking the Tower is a full-length, non-canon, Henry Stickmin fangame - a love letter to the series made in Adobe Animate by a group of fans known as Strobe Interactive.

COMING SOON TO NEWGROUNDS!

SYNOPSIS:
Set after the events of Stealing the Diamond, Henry returns home to find that his house has been destroyed and his Tunisian diamond stolen by the Tower Gang, a group of thieves second only to the Toppat Clan. Seeking revenge, Henry accepts a challenge from the Tower Gang's leader - the Towerhead, to take them down himself.
